content_blocks.label: clause_1._TESTATOR'S_NAME_AND_ADDRESS
content_blocks.text: I, Geraldine S. Maple, residing at 456 Elm Avenue, Greenwood County, State of Novamont, do hereby make, publish, and declare this to be my last will and testament.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_EXECUTOR
content_blocks.text: I appoint Henry D. Birch, residing at 789 Oak Lane, Greenwood County, State of Novamont, as the Executor of my estate.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._DISPOSAL_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: My personal property, including but not limited to furniture, jewelry, and bank accounts, shall be divided equally among my children: James Maple, Jane Maple, and John Maple.
